changelog: Merged the critic's four candidate rules into [Priority Rules] as demotions: boundaries that end on a bare object NP after a preceding personal name/title, boundaries that end on an ethnonym/demonym before a locative PP or comma-set appositive, boundaries splitting coordinated verb phrases that share a following PP/comparative, and boundaries that cut inside non-finite participial modifiers are all allowed but ranked lower.
Clarified [When to Segment] to instruct the model to still mark these positions as candidates (do not ban) while delegating them to lower confidence per the Priority Rules.
